lists.name: Sites

columns.name: Nation

lists.name: Staff

lists.name: Responses_{yyyy}
lists.purpose: One list per business-date year (Responses_2026, Responses_2027…): one row per final answer, written at Finish and on each correction, never edited. Create every index before go-live: SharePoint Online can refuse a new index once a list passes 5,000 items, and this list passes that in about 4 days

columns.name: Title

columns.name: CheckpointId

libraries.name: Maginhawa App Checklists
libraries.purpose: For people: one PDF per restaurant per day (missed days too) and one Excel file per restaurant per month, made from the lists
libraries.notes: Read-only for everyone; only Netlify Functions write. Folders {Site name}/{yyyy-MM}, e.g. Bunso/2026-11/. Files: '2026-11-06 Bunso – Fri.pdf', '2026-11-05 Bunso – Thu – MISSED.pdf', 'Bunso – Checklists – Nov 2026.xlsx'. Day PDF made after closing by a background function (PDFKit or react-pdf), remade after a correction (versions keep the old one); monthly XLSX rebuilt nightly (ExcelJS) and replaced whole. Columns: SiteCode (I), BusinessDateKey (I, blank on the monthly file), Kind Day PDF/Month XLSX (I), DayStatus (I), DayKey, BuiltAt. Automatic version limits; no sensitivity labels (they stop the app reading files). Inspectors get a view-only createLink with an expiry. Per-restaurant folder permissions: open decision. Keep 3 years proposed (KeepPeriods)

libraries.name: Photos
libraries.purpose: Check, signature, fault and work-order photos
libraries.notes: Write-once, uploaded with conflictBehavior=fail; compressed on device (~300 KB). Folders {Site name}/{yyyy-MM}/{yyyy-MM-dd}/{Checklist name}/, e.g. Bunso/2026-11/2026-11-06/Opening checks/. Readable file names '{Checkpoint title} – HH:MM.jpg', ' (2)' added on a clash; folder and file names are set at upload and never renamed (a renamed checklist keeps old folders). The app links by PhotoId, never by path. Faults and work orders use {Site name}/{yyyy-MM}/{yyyy-MM-dd}/Faults/. Columns: PhotoId (IU), Kind (I), Status Active/Removed (I), RemovedAt/ById/Reason, SiteCode, BusinessDateKey, DayKey (I), RunKey, CheckpointId, AnswerKey (I), Sha256, CapturedAt, UploadedAt, UploadedById. Shown through /api/photos; URLs never stored. Small copies printed in the day PDF and inspection pack. Keep about 12 months unless tied to an incident (open decision)
